name: BIMB
recent: 近期主要为 EPF 的股东权益变动申报，以及两名董事的变动。公司于 2026 年 8 月 26 日公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度业绩。
notable: EPF 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报股东权益变动。
Dato' Wan Mohd Fadzmi Bin Che Wan Othman Fadzilah 于 2026 年 8 月 26 日出现董事会变动。
Tan Sri Dr Ismail Hj. Bakar 于 2026 年 8 月 21 日出现董事会变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 718.77 million，净利润为 MYR 139.12 million，净利率 19.4%。营收环比增长 15.7%，净利润环比增长 20.9%；营收同比增长 9.9%，净利润同比增长 9.8%。

recent_en: Recent filings mainly relate to EPF's changes in substantial shareholder interests and two boardroom changes. The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 26 August 2026.
notable_en: EPF filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests between October and November 2026.
Boardroom change involving Dato' Wan Mohd Fadzmi Bin Che Wan Othman Fadzilah on 26 August 2026.
Boardroom change involving Tan Sri Dr Ismail Hj. Bakar on 21 August 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 718.77 million and net income was MYR 139.12 million, with a net margin of 19.4%. Revenue rose 15.7% QoQ and net income rose 20.9% QoQ; revenue grew 9.9% YoY and net income grew 9.8% YoY.
